Finally, use the quadratic formula x = [-b ± √(Δ)] / (2a) to find the solutions.

To find stationary points, you first need to find the derivative of the function f(x). Then, set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x. The values of x that satisfy this equation are the x-coordinates of the stationary points.
